notes.title: 1st of June - SPAGHETTI update
notes.content:
[img]http://www.heartbit-interactive.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/spaghetti-update.jpg[/img]
[b]The horrors of Demons Island await you, along with renewed graphics, a more balanced gameplay experience, secrets and a brand new level cap![/b]

[h1]The Story Update #3 is available NOW![/h1]
Launch the game and let it download the latest new content :NigelAdv:

Check the complete list of fancy features added in this new demonic update:[list]
[*]Take a trip to Demons Island, a dangerous isle full of challenges and freaks.
[*]Level cap raised to level 55.
[*]The Summoner has been fully rebalanced. We buffed his magic spells and summons, making him more powerful than ever!
[*]You can finally see enemies’ stats, level, type, weaknesses (reach Chapter 3 to unlock this new feature).
[*]Graphics update: the world of Doom & Destiny will improve his appearance with every new update!
[*]Removed the CURSED status. We added two new temporary and positive statuses obtainable by resting and praying (they provide exp and gold boost).
[*]Flying Spaghetti Monster statues can now be used by ANYONE and provide the Blessed status.
[*]The food cauldrons can now be used by ANYONE and provide the Well-rested status.
[*]16 new costumes for a wide choice of customization.
[*]17 new Arena battle postcards.
[*]Level up screen "under maintenance". Right now, the screen shows how many times a stat has been selected and the gear you're equipping. We plan to improve it even further in the next updates!
[*]Healing powers now heal negative statuses.
[*]Perk fix: Bag of Holding doesn't give you Stuff anymore.
[*]Bard's Soporific Serenade is now faster and cheaper.
[*]Shield on Other doesn't counter Summoning spell anymore.
[*]Fixed the annoying Arena bug that counted "battle won as defender" as lost.
[*]Fixed some problems of the Summoner’s spells.
[*]General bug fix (as the [String not set] error).[/list]
#NerdsNeverDie :PizzaAdv:

notes.title: Update 23th of February - MACCHERONI update
notes.content:
[img]http://www.heartbit-interactive.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/1.png[/img]

[b]the MACCHERONI update is now LIVE![/b]

[h1]NEW ARENA features![/h1]

Ladies and gentlemen,
we worked hard to deliver a new bombastic experience in the ARENA adding new features like:
- SELECT the OPPONENT to fight from a choice of 3 : wait 15 minutes to get a new choice or spend a Doomstone to refresh the choice instantly;
- unlock and equip special PERKS that change the outcome of the battle: get a resource boost or hinder the opponent's ability to cast spells, hire a friendly v.i.p. or explosive decoys... the choice is up to you!
- each class now has an ELEMENTAL WEAKNESS and a few TYPE to take in consideration when fighting monsters and other players;
- overall POWER rebalance:
	* Changed Sorcerer's Ice Spear to Dragon's Tear, a pure fire alchemical attack;
	* Changed Sorcerer's Arcane Earthquake with Lightning Storm;
	* Changed the Sorcerer's Lightning Storm with "Summon Lightning";
	* Sorcerer's Combustion is now "Dark Flame"
	* Barbarian's Intimidating Scream has been changed to give Fire, Ice and Lightnining resistence. It also uses Food
	* Barbarian's Lightning Strike is now Almighty Attack
	* Barbarian's Whirling Attack is now Fire Dance
	* Black Guard's Blood Freeze has been changed to Freezing Flail
	* Black Guard's Instill Dread has been changed to Vile Bile Bomb
	* Rogue's Entangling Bag now uses Alchemy
	* Rogue's Stunning Attack is now Poison Dagger
	* Rogue's Old Coins is now Double Strike
	* Warrior's Righteous Cleave is now Thunderous Smite
	* Warrior's Holy Gust is now Cleansing Strike
	* Warrior's Holy Whirl is now pure Holy and costs Golz
	* Cook's A la Julien is now Piezoelectric and vice versa
	* Cook's A la Julien is half profane
	* Void Wind Nerfed
- Summons have been rebalanced. They now have the conjurer stats +/- bonus
- Fixed Fire Ball Animation
- Fixed Arena victory screen issue
- Item Powers are now sorted: Hp healing > Hp healing  > Regen > Resurrection > Escape > Attack. Food > Alchemy > Stuff > Money and Void
- General bug fixes ːNigelAdvː
#NerdsNeverDie

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.heartbit-interactive.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/faq-you.png[/img]
[h1]WHAT IS AN EARLY ACCESS?[/h1]
It's like playing a sort of [b]BETA[/b]: a game still in development. Bugs and glitches are common, but over all, our version od Do&De Adv it's a very stable release. [b]Content will be added during development[/b]! You are getting access to a game before its full release.

[h1]DO I HAVE TO BUY IT AGAIN WHEN THE RELEASE IS READY?[/h1]
[b]NO![/b] Buy it now and you get the full version and all its update once they are ready!

[h1]WHEN THE FULL VERSION WILL BE READY?[/h1]
We don't know it yet. [b]Probably late 2015 or early 2016[/b].

[h1]WILL THE FULL VERSION COST MORE?[/h1]
We don't know it yet, but probably it will cost more. If you want to get Doom & Destiny for cheap, [b]get it now at launch[/b] :D

[h1]WHEN THE MOBILE VERSION WILL BE AVAILABLE?[/h1]
After we fix some more bugs, we will launch Doom & Destiny Advanced on mobile as an "early access / beta". [b]We need to work a little more[/b] to have a stable mobile version.

[h1]IF I BUY THE EARLY ACCESS DO I GET THE MOBILE VERSION TOO?[/h1]
[b]No, sorry[/b]. We can't bypass the mobile store to let you have the full retail version of Doom & Destiny Advanced. If you want to play Do&De Adv on your phone/tablet, you'll have to buy it again on the mobile store.

[h1]DO I HAVE TO BUY IT AGAIN WHEN THE RELEASE IS READY?[/h1]
[b]NO![/b] Buy it now and you get the full version and all its update once they are ready!

[h1]WHEN THE FULL VERSION WILL BE READY?[/h1]
We don't know it yet. [b]Probably late 2015 or early 2016[/b].

[h1]WILL THE FULL VERSION COST MORE?[/h1]
We don't know it yet, but probably it will cost more. If you want to get Doom & Destiny for cheap, [b]get it now at launch[/b] :D

[h1]WHEN THE MOBILE VERSION WILL BE AVAILABLE?[/h1]
After we fix some more bugs, we will launch Doom & Destiny Advanced on mobile as an "early access / beta". [b]We need to work a little more[/b] to have a stable mobile version.

[h1]IF I BUY THE EARLY ACCESS DO I GET THE MOBILE VERSION TOO?[/h1]
[b]No, sorry[/b]. We can't bypass the mobile store to let you have the full retail version of Doom & Destiny Advanced. If you want to play Do&De Adv on your phone/tablet, you'll have to buy it again on the mobile store.
